title: Nonlocal Boundary Conditions for Truncated-Fractional Differential Equations Posed on Bounded Domains
summary: Nonlocal models have found great success in recent years. In particular, models that replace spatial derivatives with strongly singular integral operators involving finite interaction radii are used in a wide range of applications, including image processing, continuum mechanics, and many other areas. However, from the perspective of mathematical analysis, difficulties arise when considering the appropriate notion of ``boundary'' conditions.
